comments.author: @FarawayPlaces.09
comments.text: (50:50) “marking a major leap for the energy industry.” I’m amazed by how these engineering projects combine bold imagination with practical solutions, especially the Baihetan Dam’s contribution to clean energy and the Harbin Opera House’s beautiful design that works with nature rather than against it. At the same time, the story reminds us that progress should consider the people affected by construction. Which futuristic wonder impressed you most, and what kind of innovation would you love to see in your own country?
